content.description: Article body in markdown. Supports # headings, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code`, [links](url), lists, blockquotes, fenced code blocks, GFM tables, $$LaTeX$$, horizontal rules. Reference uploaded media as ![alt](file:0), ![alt](file:1). Embed tweets as {{tweet:ID}}.
content.title: Content

cover_image.description: Cover image displayed at the top of the article
cover_image.title: Cover Image

media.description: Media files referenced in content as file:0, file:1, etc. Supports images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF) and video (MP4).
media.title: Media

publish.description: Publish immediately. Set false to save as draft only.
publish.title: Publish
